text:
kai: ran a 30-min sampling profiler on shard-b this morning; saw kernel_selector flip from avx -> triton at ~12m and a correlated KV prefix reuse collapse and eviction spike. posting snippets and dashboard asks.

maria_t: can you paste the profiler output or a short diff? :eyes: any seq_len shift?

kai: seq_len distribution was stable. main delta looks tied to a burst of small requests (<=32 tokens) on /summarize. prefix_reuse for /summarize fell ~78% -> ~42% over ~3 min, eviction rate spiked.

ashok: can you paste the sample traces?

kai: 
```
profile_id: run-20260317-09
route: /summarize
kernel_sequence: [avx, avx, triton, triton, triton, avx]
kernel_confidence: 0.3
kvcache_prefix_hits: 2304
kvcache_prefix_requests: 5480
kvcache_evictions: 512
kvcache_mem_bytes: 1.2GB
prefix_reuse_by_route: {"/summarize": 0.42, "/chat": 0.82}
notes: small-batch burst + allocator fragmentation windows seen in logs
```

jen: that reuse delta is alarming. smells like a prefetch/stride estimator misfire or policy TTL interaction.

samir: also saw concurrent allocator compaction/Gc events in infra logs at same timeframe; fragmentation + small allocations could make eviction behave worse.

maria_t: proposal for instrumentation and dashboards: add per-route metrics for prefix_reuse_ratio, eviction_count_by_reason (mem_pressure / policy / ttl), eviction_age_histogram, and kernel_switch_count. also token-level latency split (gen vs kvcache lookup vs kernel switch).

kai: yes — token-level p50/p95/p99 split so we know if kvcache lookup is dominating tail. and we need kernel_selector.reason tag (heuristic / fallback / hotpath) for correlation.

ashok: suggested PromQL for prefix_reuse_by_route: 
```promql
sum by (route) (rate(kvcache_prefix_hits_total[5m])) / sum by (route) (rate(kvcache_prefix_requests_total[5m]))
```

jen: eviction_age histogram idea: 
```promql
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(kvcache_eviction_age_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))
```

samir: also instrument kernel_selector.reason and eviction_reason tags in telemetry so we can slice by cause. add a 1% sampled full kernel decision trace to perf-store for manual triage.

kai: dashboard asks (short):
- heatmap: per-route prefix_reuse_ratio (color by drop delta)
- timeline: kernel_switch_count overlay with token p99
- donut: eviction causes by percent
- table: top routes by mem_bytes and reuse delta

maria_t: i'll sketch the dashboard mock and push a PR. ETA: EOD tomorrow for mock; follow-up with JSON import.

ashok: I'll add kernel_selector.reason and eviction_reason tags in the telemetry pipeline. ETA: 2 days.

jen: I'll add 1% sampled kernel decision traces and wire perf-store ingestion.

perf-bot: profiler-run-20260317 completed; anomaly detected; ticket INF-1721 created.

kai: created INF ticket https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-1721 — linking findings and sample traces. can we add an alert: reuse_drop > 20% over 5m for any route? :raised_hands:

maria_t: yes, add alert but mute for routes with low request volume. include runbook steps (pin kernel avx for /summarize as fallback, clear prefetch window).

samir: quick question — is Dedicated traffic affected or just Hosted?

kai: initial query shows impact confined to hosted.

jen: note for runbook: fallback pinning to avx for /summarize if reuse < 50% and token_p99 > baseline.

maria_t: opening PR for dashboard + alert now, will link to INF-1721.

kai: thanks all :clap:

maria_t: leaving next steps in the ticket and assigning to @ashok @jen @maria_t
